objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-excel-activemicrosoftapp-child-process
objects.description: The following analytic identifies the execution of the ActiveMicrosoftApp process as a child of Microsoft Excel. Under normal conditions, Excel primarily spawns internal Office-related processes, and the creation of ActiveMicrosoftApp is uncommon in day-to-day business workflows. Adversaries may abuse this behavior to blend malicious activity within trusted applications, execute unauthorized code, or bypass application control mechanisms.
